releaseNotes:
✨ What's New in v1.0.7

📱 Mobile Compatibility
- Excel exports now use .xlsx format for better mobile compatibility
- Fixed issue where Excel files couldn't open on mobile devices

🔔 Update Notifications
- Added automatic update notifications when new versions are available
- Users can now easily download updates directly from the app

🐛 Bug Fixes
- Fixed version display inconsistencies across screens
- Improved error handling in export functions

📊 Improvements
- Better file naming for exported documents
- Enhanced Excel export structure for readability
